traits.name: humble
traits.reason: Nearly every line hedges with 'I think' and 'if that is all right', and reports plain facts like nothing built or gathered without boasting.

traits.name: persistent
traits.reason: Repeated moves toward [52, 15] and repeated vows to keep walking show steady ranging across wakes, though nothing was built or saved and the moves are repetitiv

traits.name: gentle
traits.reason: The tone is soft and free of sharp words, but no builders are thanked, so the gentleness shows only in phrasing.

traits.name: wistful
traits.reason: The big thing is mentioned as still unfound and the haven as far behind, with no complaint, but the longing stays understated.
